name: 46635 · South Bend, IN
findings: ZIP 46635 (South Bend) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46635 (South Bend) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46635 (South Bend) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
